name: Biting Blade
body:
School transmutation; Level ranger 2. sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, F (the weapon)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target weapon touched
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell may be cast only on slashing or piercing weapons to cause them to bite deeper into an opponent’s flesh. This effectively raises the weapon’s damage die by one size for the duration of the spell using the normal rule for weapon die type advancement. Thus a dagger that normally inflicts 1d4 points of damage would inflict 1d6, while a greatsword would inflict 3d6 points of damage instead of its regular 2d6. A weapon that inflicts 1d12 points of damage inflicts 3d6 points of damage when affected by this spell.
